scientific_integrity: Proof conditional on exact unrestricted-trait PDE; source manuscript and conceptual predecessor explicitly credited; numerical evidence not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Full-real-line deterministic infectivity mutation, compact initial trait support, positive initial infected mass and positive contact/recovery; negative and greater-than-one traits arise, so final-size jump is not a biological or stochastic forecast.
title: Sharp zero-diffusion final-size singularity for unbounded infectivity evolution
